name: net/http request to a user-controlled URL (SSRF)
attack_scenario: Attacker sets the webhook/avatar URL to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/; the server fetches it and returns the instance's IAM credentials.
negative_test_hint: submit the callback URL "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/" and assert the server refuses to fetch it, blocking link-local and private ranges

exemplar.explanation: http.Get/Post/Head/PostForm and http.NewRequest fetch whatever URL they are handed. Building that URL from user input via Sprintf or literal+concatenation lets an attacker point the server at internal services or the cloud metadata endpoint. Fetch only fixed constant targets or hosts validated against an allowlist, and block link-local/private ranges (169.254.169.254, 127/8, 10/8, 192.168/16) before making the request.
